task: Transcribe this Hindi voice note and give me English subtitles as an SRT file
summary: Transcribed the provided Hindi voice note and generated a verified English subtitles SRT.
assumptions: Same input audio as originally provided.

plan.plan: 1) Call transcribe_audio on the provided WAV to get an Indic transcript and a Hindi-timed SRT (cost based on ~0.16 audio minutes). 2) Call translate_text on the generated Hindi SRT to English to create an English SRT with the same timing. 3) Call verify_translation to ensure the English SRT structurally matches the Hindi source.
assumptions: The audio is indeed Hindi; if language detection is uncertain, the tool will auto-detect and still produce an SRT in the detected language.
The user wants literal English subtitle translation (not a separate narration).
